The '''Inferno firefighting robo''' was developed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to put out fires. They were very tough and were able to stand even the hottest of flames. They used chemical foam to extinguish fires, and also had a searchlight and a loudspeaker.

==Description==
Inferno firefighting units utilized a modular and versatile design, which was widely considered to be one of the most innovative emergency service [[Droid/Legends|droids]] ever created.<ref name="EGTD" /> They were small, boxy droids, standing just over a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall.<ref name="FF79" /> Infernos featured a small head mounted on the droid's left side which contained a number of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], including an [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] and an [[echolocation scanner]], as well as a [[Spotlight/Legends|searchlight]] and a [[Speaker/Legends|loudspeaker]].<ref name="EGTD" /> The head also contained a highly sophisticated [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] in order to perform their complex and difficult duties, as well as coordinating with organic rescue personnel.<ref name="FF79" />

Inferno units were covered in tough [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and sheathed in a [[heat-resistant alloy]] coating, allowing the droid to survive extreme temperatures. A hose with a spray nozzle was ventrally mounted on the Inferno which could release a high-pressured discharge of [[fire suppressant foam]]. This foam was effective at smothering most electrical and chemical based blazes,<ref name="EGTD" /> and other suppressants could be loaded into the droid if the situation called for it.<ref name="FF79" /> A retractable [[Laser cutter/Legends|laser cutter]] was used to cut through doors and wreckage, while two heavy [[Grasper arm/Legends|gripper arms]] were commonly used to move unconscious victims to safety although they had originally been designed to allow the Inferno to manipulate machinery.<ref name="EGTD" />

==Role==
Infernos were not designed to be deployed as a singular unit; rather, they were deployed in teams. A standard Inferno system consisted of four [[Firefighter droid/Legends|firefighter droids]] which were linked to a [[host carrier]] equipped with a military-grade [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. When a fire alarm was raised, the host carrier was deployed to the scene. Upon arrival, the individual units detached from the carrier and sped into action, either acting as a single cohesive squad, or using their repulsors to tackle the blaze from different elevations. In the event of a larger crisis, multiple Inferno systems were carried to the site on [[Transport/Legends|cargo transport]]s.<ref name="EGTD" />

Infernos linked to one another using a locking clip on the droid's underside that connected to a corresponding groove in the droid's dorsal surface. Infernos could be stacked on top of each other to form a tall firefighting tower, but they were commonly deployed in teams of two facing in opposite directions. This allowed the combined droids to spray foam in two directions at once while moving through a burning building. The host carrier was built around a large tank containing compressed fire suppression foam, and the Infernos returned to the carrier once their own supplies were exhausted to be replenished. Each carrier had eight fueling hoses to resupply their Infernos.<ref name="EGTD" />

==History==
The Inferno firefighting robo was developed by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] to operate in environments that were hostile to organic lifeforms.<ref name="EGTD" /> However, the loss of life from fires were not the Authority's primary reason for producing the droid. To the Authority, the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of numerous workers were of little concern. Instead, the Inferno was designed to prevent damage to the Authority's extensive industrial and manufacturing facilities.<ref name="FF79" />

The success of the units led to them becoming a common sight in governmental and private [[fire station]]s throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], with even backwater worlds like [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]] having teams of Infernos stationed at their [[clan fortress]]es and the local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Outside the Corporate Sector, Inferno units quietly grew in popularity<ref name="EGTD" /> becoming increasingly common on [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="FF79" />
